<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="external-pos-annotations">
<h1>External POS annotations</h1>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">abbr2words</span></code> accepts optional provider-neutral token annotations for
applications that already tokenize and tag text. The package remains
dependency-free: it does not install, import, or decode any NLP provider.</p>
<section id="tokenannotation">
<h2>TokenAnnotation</h2>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">abbr2words</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">TokenAnnotation</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">abbr2words</span>

<span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;They wandered around in. The board is 10 in. wide.&quot;</span>
<span class="n">annotations</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
    <span class="n">TokenAnnotation</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;PRON&quot;</span><span class="p">),</span>
    <span class="c1"># ...one source-aligned annotation for each token...</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">abbr2words</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">annotations</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">annotations</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">start</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">end</span></code> are Python character offsets, and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text[start:end]</span></code> must be
the token span in the original source. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pos</span></code> is an optional uppercase coarse
Universal POS label such as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ADP</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">NOUN</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PROPN</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">NUM</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PUNCT</span></code>; <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tag</span></code> can
hold a provider-specific fine-grained label. Whitespace gaps are allowed, but
token spans may not overlap. Labels are normalized to uppercase and empty labels
become <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">None</span></code>.</p>
<p>A bare POS vector is not accepted because it cannot identify which source
characters belong to each label. Missing annotations or missing POS labels
preserve the normal structural behavior: POS guards refine a decision only when
usable lexical POS evidence is present, so incomplete evidence fails open.</p>
<p>Context profiles may use neighboring annotations as high-confidence evidence
for language-specific decisions. All annotation and replacement offsets remain
relative to the original, unexpanded source. <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">protected_spans</span></code> can be supplied
alongside annotations; invalid or overlapping protected ranges raise an error
and protected ranges take precedence over candidates.</p>
</section>
<section id="what-pos-changes-today">
<h2>What POS changes today</h2>
<p>POS constraints are opt-in and currently affect custom entries only. No bundled
registry entry currently requires a POS label. Do not add a registry-wide POS
constraint without corpus evidence for the relevant language and tagger.</p>
<p>The <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tag</span></code> field is retained for adapters and future extensions, but the current
guard matcher evaluates only coarse <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pos</span></code> labels.</p>
</section>
<section id="spacy-adapter">
<h2>spaCy adapter</h2>
<p>spaCy exposes the required offsets and labels directly on its tokens:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">spacy</span>

<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">abbr2words</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">TokenAnnotation</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">abbr2words</span>

<span class="n">nlp</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">spacy</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">load</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;en_core_web_sm&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;They wandered around in. The board is 10 in. wide.&quot;</span>
<span class="n">doc</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">nlp</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">examples.spacy_pos</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">to_token_annotations</span>

<span class="n">annotations</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">to_token_annotations</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">doc</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">abbr2words</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">annotations</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">annotations</span><span class="p">))</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Run <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">python</span> <span class="pre">examples/spacy_pos.py</span></code> for a complete lazy-import example. A
trained spaCy pipeline component is required for POS predictions; tokenization
alone does not populate <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">token.pos_</span></code>.</p>
</section>
<section id="pos-guard-precedence-and-limitations">
<h2>POS guard precedence and limitations</h2>
<p>Custom entries may use <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">only_if_pos=&quot;NOUN&quot;</span></code>,
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">only_if_pos={&quot;NOUN&quot;,</span> <span class="pre">&quot;PROPN&quot;}</span></code>, or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">not_if_pos=&quot;ADP&quot;</span></code>. The decision order is:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p>source offsets, regex boundaries, and structural guards;</p></li>
<li><p>reviewed numeric-unit matching;</p></li>
<li><p>POS deny constraints (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">not_if_pos</span></code>);</p></li>
<li><p>POS allow constraints (<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">only_if_pos</span></code>);</p></li>
<li><p>context selection and replacement conflict resolution.</p></li>
</ol>
<p>Punctuation, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">SPACE</span></code>, and missing POS labels do not provide lexical evidence.
When both POS constraints match, the deny constraint wins.</p>
<p>Reviewed numeric unit expressions remain authoritative. For example, a general
tagger labeling the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">in</span></code> in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">10</span> <span class="pre">in.</span></code> as <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ADP</span></code> does not prevent the result
<code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">10</span> <span class="pre">inch</span></code>. The sentence-final <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">in.</span></code> example demonstrates structural guarding and
annotation alignment; it does not claim that POS caused the decision.</p>
<p>The adapter helper in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">examples/spacy_pos.py</span></code> accepts any iterable exposing
spaCy’s <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">idx</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">pos_</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">tag_</span></code>, and token length attributes. A trained spaCy
pipeline component is required for POS predictions; tokenization alone does not
populate <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">token.pos_</span></code>.</p>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
